title: Sunday · the boat launch
logline: The boat launch in November, the ramp slick, the tide out, the Datsun at the top with the dog's head out the window. The first Sunday where the color behaves.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the concrete ramp going down into gray water, weed at the tideline, one gull on the piling. The color behaving for the first time.
